about.privacyBody: Free Speech runs on your device: your board, settings and usage are stored only in this browser (local storage). No data is sent to any server, no tracking cookies, no third-party analytics.
about.guideBody:
1. Concepts: each button is a pictogram; grouped into collections (feelings, food, actions...). The top bar builds the sentence spoken aloud.
  2. Edit the board: tap the pencil icon to enter edit mode — add pictograms (ARASAAC search or custom image), edit label and color, drag to reorder.
  3. Passcode lock: enable Access code in Settings so children cannot edit or change settings without the PIN. Keep it safe: there is no recovery.
  4. Voices: Settings → Voice lists every voice installed on the device — test each one.
  5. Size and contrast: Settings → pictogram size, tile size and high contrast for low vision or reduced motor skills.
  6. Backups: the board lives in the device browser. Use Export regularly; Import copies the board to another device.
  7. Offline: after first load the app works offline, pictograms included.
  8. Direct typing: on sites embedding the A11Y PRO widget, each pictogram can type directly into forms.
